tasks.short: Direct or assist equipment maintenance and repair

steps.what: Direct or assist workers maintaining or repairing power tools and motorized equipment

tasks.design: Retain on-site direction and practical assistance. Existing repair instructions in {DOCS} remain reference material; no paperwork or automated repair baseline is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is physical supervision and assistance at the equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is assumed to replace practical work.
tasks.still_hard: Safe isolation, actual faults and worker competence require direct attention.
tasks.human_edge: Stop an unsafe repair attempt and recognise when specialist help is necessary.
tasks.altitude: Practical supervision and maintenance authority stay unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve a repair beyond the crew's competence
reach.learn: Fault descriptions, safe isolation and escalation

evidence.claim: Hands-on equipment maintenance supervision requires physical observation and competent judgement; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor direction and assistance, excluding other workers' repair effort and separate maintenance records. Only supervisor labour is in the denominator.
Supervisor observes equipment and worker actions in s1 with all time retained. No structured fault code or new form is required; uncertain repair instructions lead to existing specialist escalation.
Native reference access is considered first. Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed; existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Which repairs should be escalated instead of attempted on site?

incremental.description: Unchanged practical workflow needs no added upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and upkeep 0. Routine maintenance and difficult repairs retain all supervisor time; no invented administration is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine job requirements from contracts and assignments

steps.what: Review contracts and work assignments and capture service scope and site constraints
Calculate service hours and machine requirements from checked work quantities
Determine workforce, machine and service requirements after resolving scope ambiguities

tasks.design: Configure native job-calculation features in {OPS_SYSTEM} or checked {SPREADSHEET} formulas before custom code. The supervisor retains contract interpretation, quantity capture, norm selection and the final determination of feasible resources.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated arithmetic between interpreted work quantities and resource norms.
tasks.enabler_now: Sector planning tools already support work-package calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, access, terrain and ambiguous service standards change realistic requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when standard work norms do not fit the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Less resource arithmetic with unchanged contract and feasibility judgement.

reach.task: Resolve a resource shortfall before accepting the work plan
reach.learn: Scope assumptions, work norms and site-specific constraints

evidence.claim: Suite MKB supports landscaper planning and calculation from standard work packages.
The proposed time allocation and saving are an unmeasured scenario, not a sourced labour result.

assumptions: Boundary ends with job resource requirements, excluding pricing, shift assignment and performance of the work.

Supervisor produces scope rows in s1: contract version, site, work type, quantity, unit, frequency, time window and constraints. Full capture and interpretation time remains. Existing norm owner supplies versioned unit time and machine assumptions; supervisor checks applicability in s2 within retained time. Missing quantities or unsuitable norms require manual calculation in s2 and judgement in s3.
Test native job calculation first. No model interprets contract obligations or automatically assigns staff. Existing runtime earns no saving; norm maintenance is charged below.
unknowns: Quality of site quantities and existing norms
research_questions: Does configured calculation save time after scope capture and norm applicability checks?

already_counted.description: Check norm selection and calculation exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain work norms and calculation rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=86; gross 14 less upkeep 3 gives net 11. High assumes repeat work packages; low assumes bespoke site constraints consume arithmetic gains. Interpretation and final requirements retain 80 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order corrective work and recommend procedural changes

steps.what: Investigate work problems and discuss causes with the people involved
Order appropriate corrective work and explain immediate priorities
Recommend procedural changes to prevent the problem recurring

tasks.design: Retain site investigation, corrective instructions and discussion of procedural changes. Existing procedures in {DOCS} remain references; no automatic cause diagnosis or generic paperwork saving is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Corrective choices depend on the actual cause and site constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is assumed to replace those decisions.
tasks.still_hard: The apparent cause may differ from the underlying process problem.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a practical correction without blaming a worker for a system constraint.
tasks.altitude: Corrective-work and recommendation responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.task: Assess whether a suggested procedure change is practical across sites

evidence.claim: Site-specific corrective work and prevention recommendations require contextual human judgement; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary excludes crew execution, formal record maintenance and management adoption of procedure changes. Their effort is not transferred or credited as a saving.

Supervisor gathers observations and accounts in s1 with full time retained. No structured cause code, automated problem score or additional data capture is required; uncertain causes need more investigation through the existing process.
Native reference tools are considered first. Zero incremental upkeep because the workflow is unchanged, and existing runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: Which recurring problems require a process change rather than another local correction?

incremental.description: Unchanged investigation and correction workflow adds no upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 with upkeep 0. Routine corrections and complex investigations retain their time; no unobserved report-writing step is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on landscaping maintenance and improvement plans

steps.what: Prepare current landscaping plans, schedules and site constraints for discussion
Confer with managers or landscape architects to develop feasible plans or schedules

tasks.design: Use a saved {PROJECT} view and native {DOCS} meeting template to assemble the existing plan and work status. The supervisor checks currency and retains the full planning discussion with managers or the landscape architect.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying of established plan and status information for meetings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can reuse existing project facts.
tasks.still_hard: Design intent, available resources and changing site conditions must be reconciled through discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Explain practical maintenance constraints before an attractive design becomes an unworkable plan.
tasks.altitude: Less discussion-pack assembly with unchanged collaborative planning responsibility.

reach.task: Adapt a design to maintenance and site constraints
reach.learn: Design intent, seasonal work and practical access

evidence.claim: Suite MKB supports planning for landscapers; native planning views are a plausible basis for discussion-pack reuse, not a measured meeting saving.
The pack-assembly allocation and saving are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers supervisor preparation and discussion, excluding detailed design, crew scheduling and other participants' meeting time.

Project owners produce the existing plan and status through their unchanged process. Supervisor selects site, plan version, reporting date and relevant constraints in s1; selection, factual capture and currency checks remain within retained 60%. Missing updates are clarified manually before discussion rather than treated as complete work.
Test native project views before custom code. No automatic plan agreement or change to design authority; existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Does a saved view reduce pack assembly after currency checks?

already_counted.description: Select current facts and check the discussion pack

incremental.description: Maintain the pack view and template

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92; gross 8 minus upkeep 2 gives net 6. High assumes repeated pack copying; low assumes missing updates consume the gain. Planning discussion retains 80 hours.

role.altitude: The supervisor keeps practical direction and collaborative decisions, with less resource arithmetic and preparation copying.
reach: Help operations managers and landscape architects understand site and maintenance constraints
role.ambitious_version: Make realistic grounds plans and corrective decisions from clear site evidence.
